023package org.opt4j.gatekeeper.djl;
024
025import ai.djl.Model;
026import ai.djl.inference.Predictor;
027import ai.djl.ndarray.NDArray;
028import ai.djl.ndarray.NDList;
029import ai.djl.ndarray.NDManager;
030import ai.djl.ndarray.types.Shape;
031import ai.djl.nn.Activation;
032import ai.djl.nn.SequentialBlock;
033import ai.djl.nn.core.Linear;
034import ai.djl.training.DefaultTrainingConfig;
035import ai.djl.training.GradientCollector;
036import ai.djl.training.Trainer;
037import ai.djl.training.dataset.ArrayDataset;
038import ai.djl.training.dataset.Batch;
039import ai.djl.training.dataset.Dataset;
040import ai.djl.training.listener.TrainingListener;
041import ai.djl.training.loss.Loss;
042import ai.djl.training.optimizer.Optimizer;
043import ai.djl.training.tracker.Tracker;
044import ai.djl.translate.NoopTranslator;
045import com.google.inject.Inject;
046import com.google.inject.Provider;
047import com.google.inject.Singleton;
048import org.opt4j.core.start.Constant;
049import org.opt4j.gatekeeper.DominancePredictionManager;
050import org.opt4j.gatekeeper.GatekeeperModel;
051
052import java.util.List;
053
054@Singleton
055public class DjlDominancePredictor implements GatekeeperModel {
056
057    private final GatekeeperMetricsTracker metricsTracker;
058    private final Provider<DominancePredictionManager> dominanceManagerProvider;    // Used just to get current counters/metrics
059                                                                                    // Wrap DominancePredictionManager with a Provider to fix circular dependency error
060    private final int hiddenLayerCount;
061    private final int hiddenLayerSize;
062    private final float learningRate;
063    private final float predictionThreshold;
064    private final float falsePositivePenalty;
065    private final int batchSize;
066    private final boolean useGpu;
067
068    private boolean initialized = false;
069    private int features;
070
071    private NDManager baseManager;
072    private Model model;
073    private Trainer trainer;
074
075    // ThreadLocal ensures lock-free concurrent inference for Opt4J Worker Threads
076    private ThreadLocal<Predictor<NDList, NDList>> predictorPool;
077
078    @Inject
079    public DjlDominancePredictor(
080            GatekeeperMetricsTracker metricsTracker,
081            Provider<DominancePredictionManager> dominanceManagerProvider,
082            DjlInitializerService initService, // Forces eager initialization of native libs
083            @Constant(value = "hiddenLayerCount", namespace = org.opt4j.gatekeeper.NeuralGatekeeperModule.class) int hiddenLayerCount,
084            @Constant(value = "hiddenLayerSize", namespace = org.opt4j.gatekeeper.NeuralGatekeeperModule.class) int hiddenLayerSize,
085            @Constant(value = "learningRate", namespace = org.opt4j.gatekeeper.NeuralGatekeeperModule.class) double learningRate,
086            @Constant(value = "predictionThreshold", namespace = org.opt4j.gatekeeper.NeuralGatekeeperModule.class) double predictionThreshold,
087            @Constant(value = "falsePositivePenalty", namespace = org.opt4j.gatekeeper.NeuralGatekeeperModule.class) double falsePositivePenalty,
088            @Constant(value = "batchSize", namespace = org.opt4j.gatekeeper.NeuralGatekeeperModule.class) int batchSize,
089            @Constant(value = "useGpu", namespace = org.opt4j.gatekeeper.NeuralGatekeeperModule.class) boolean useGpu){
090
091        this.metricsTracker = metricsTracker;
092        this.dominanceManagerProvider = dominanceManagerProvider;
093        this.hiddenLayerCount = hiddenLayerCount;
094        this.hiddenLayerSize = hiddenLayerSize;
095        this.learningRate = (float) learningRate;
096        this.predictionThreshold = (float) predictionThreshold;
097        this.falsePositivePenalty = (float) falsePositivePenalty;
098        this.batchSize = batchSize;
099        this.useGpu = useGpu;
100    }
101
102    private synchronized void ensureInitialized(int featureSize) {
103        if (!initialized) {
104            this.features = featureSize;
105
106            // Determine Device based on config
107            ai.djl.Device device = this.useGpu ? ai.djl.Device.gpu() : ai.djl.Device.cpu();
108            this.baseManager = NDManager.newBaseManager(device);
109            this.model = Model.newInstance("gatekeeper-binary-model", device);
110
111            SequentialBlock block = new SequentialBlock();
112            for (int i = 0; i < hiddenLayerCount; i++) {
113                block.add(Linear.builder().setUnits(hiddenLayerSize).build());
114                block.add(Activation::relu);
115            }
116            block.add(Linear.builder().setUnits(1).build()); // Single logit output
117            model.setBlock(block);
118
119            DefaultTrainingConfig config = new DefaultTrainingConfig(Loss.sigmoidBinaryCrossEntropyLoss())
120                    .optOptimizer(Optimizer.adam().optLearningRateTracker(Tracker.fixed(learningRate)).build())
121                    .optDevices(new ai.djl.Device[]{ device })
122                    .addTrainingListeners(TrainingListener.Defaults.logging());
123
124            this.trainer = model.newTrainer(config);
125            this.trainer.initialize(new Shape(this.batchSize, features));
126            this.predictorPool = ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> model.newPredictor(new NoopTranslator(), device));
127            this.initialized = true;
128        }
129    }
130
131    @Override
132    public boolean predictIsDominated(float[] newFeatures, List<float[]> archiveFeaturesList) {
133        if (archiveFeaturesList.isEmpty()) return false;
134
135        int inputFeatureSize = newFeatures.length + archiveFeaturesList.getFirst().length;
136        ensureInitialized(inputFeatureSize);
137
138        try (NDManager subManager = this.baseManager.newSubManager()) {
139            // Build the batch of [Archive, New] pairs
140            float[][] featuresArray = new float[archiveFeaturesList.size()][inputFeatureSize];
141            for (int i = 0; i < archiveFeaturesList.size(); i++) {
142                float[] archFeat = archiveFeaturesList.get(i);
143                System.arraycopy(archFeat, 0, featuresArray[i], 0, archFeat.length);
144                System.arraycopy(newFeatures, 0, featuresArray[i], archFeat.length, newFeatures.length);
145            }
146
147            NDArray inputFeatures = subManager.create(featuresArray);
148
149            // Thread-safe, lock-free prediction
150            Predictor<NDList, NDList> predictor = predictorPool.get();
151            NDArray logits = predictor.predict(new NDList(inputFeatures)).singletonOrThrow();
152
153            // Convert logits to probabilities (Sigmoid)
154            NDArray probabilities = logits.getManager().ones(logits.getShape(), logits.getDataType())
155                    .div(logits.neg().exp().add(1f));
156
157            float[] probs = probabilities.toFloatArray();
158
159            for (float p : probs) {
160                if (p > predictionThreshold) return true; // Exit if any archive individual dominates
161            }
162            return false;
163        } catch (Exception e) {
164            throw new RuntimeException("Error during prediction", e);
165        }
166    }
167
168    @Override
169    public synchronized void train(List<float[]> combinedFeatures, List<Float> labels) {
170        if (combinedFeatures.isEmpty()) return;
171        ensureInitialized(combinedFeatures.getFirst().length);
172
173        try (NDManager subManager = this.baseManager.newSubManager()) {
174            float[][] featuresArray = combinedFeatures.toArray(new float[0][]);
175            float[] labelsArray = new float[labels.size()];
176            long totalPositives = 0;
177
178            for (int i = 0; i < labels.size(); i++) {
179                labelsArray[i] = labels.get(i);
180                if (labelsArray[i] > 0.5f) totalPositives++;
181            }
182
183            long datasetSize = labels.size();
184            long totalNegatives = datasetSize - totalPositives;
185
186            // Global class weights to heavily penalize false positives
187            float globalPosWeight = (totalPositives > 0) ? (float) datasetSize / (2.0f * totalPositives) : 0.0f;
188            float globalNegWeight = (totalNegatives > 0) ? (float) datasetSize / (2.0f * totalNegatives) : 0.0f;
189            globalNegWeight *= falsePositivePenalty;
190
191            NDArray featuresND = subManager.create(featuresArray);
192            NDArray labelsND = subManager.create(labelsArray).reshape(-1, 1);
193
194            Dataset trainingData = new ArrayDataset.Builder()
195                    .setData(featuresND)
196                    .optLabels(labelsND)
197                    .setSampling(this.batchSize, false)
198                    .build();
199            
200            //init counter for internal metrics
201            long totalTP = 0;
202            long totalTN = 0;
203            long totalFP = 0;
204            long totalFN = 0;
205
206            for (Batch batch : trainingData.getData(subManager)) {
207                try {
208                    NDArray featureData = batch.getData().head();
209                    NDArray labelData = batch.getLabels().head();
210                    try (GradientCollector collector = trainer.newGradientCollector()) {
211                        // Calculate Metrics before stepping
212                        NDArray logits = trainer.forward(new NDList(featureData)).singletonOrThrow();
213                        NDArray predictedLabels = logits.gt(0.0f); // Sigmoid > 0.5
214
215                        totalTP += predictedLabels.eq(1.0f).logicalAnd(labelData.eq(1.0f)).sum().getLong();
216                        totalTN += predictedLabels.eq(0.0f).logicalAnd(labelData.eq(0.0f)).sum().getLong();
217                        totalFP += predictedLabels.eq(1.0f).logicalAnd(labelData.eq(0.0f)).sum().getLong();
218                        totalFN += predictedLabels.eq(0.0f).logicalAnd(labelData.eq(1.0f)).sum().getLong();
219
220                        // Manual Backpropagation with custom weighted loss
221                        NDArray probabilities = logits.getManager().ones(logits.getShape(), logits.getDataType()).div(logits.neg().exp().add(1f));
222                        float eps = 1e-7f;
223                        NDArray clippedProbs = probabilities.clip(eps, 1 - eps);
224
225                        NDArray posTerm = labelData.mul(clippedProbs.log()).mul(-globalPosWeight);
226                        NDArray oneMinusLabel = labelData.neg().add(1);
227                        NDArray oneMinusProb = clippedProbs.neg().add(1);
228                        NDArray negTerm = oneMinusLabel.mul(oneMinusProb.log()).mul(-globalNegWeight);
229
230                        NDArray loss = posTerm.add(negTerm).mean();
231                        collector.backward(loss);
232                    }
233                    trainer.step();
234                } finally {
235                    batch.close();
236                }
237            }
238            metricsTracker.recordBatchMetrics(totalTP, totalTN, totalFP, totalFN, dominanceManagerProvider.get().getCurrentIteration(), dominanceManagerProvider.get().getEvaluatedCount());
239        } catch (Exception e) {
240            throw new RuntimeException("Training failed", e);
241        }
242    }
243
244    @Override
245    public synchronized void close() {
246        if (metricsTracker != null) metricsTracker.close();
247
248        // Cannot close ThreadLocal variables from the main thread if they were spawned by workers,
249        // but Model/Trainer/Manager cleanup will natively release the underlying PyTorch memory.
250        if (trainer != null) { trainer.close(); trainer = null; }
251        if (model != null) { model.close(); model = null; }
252        if (baseManager != null) { baseManager.close(); baseManager = null; }
253    }
254}
